notes.title: Update 1: Bugfixes / Quality of life
notes.content:
Here is what this first small update holds:

- Gadgets behavior should be more consistent. You will no longer throw molotovs into the void.
- Boss projectiles will be destroyed if they hit you. A single projectile will no longer be able to hit you multiple times.
- Multiple small fixes and tweaks.

We are working on more bugfixes, QoL changes and visual polish as we speak.
